title: Loading SKILL.md instructions on demand with a skill menu
description: The agent receives a compact menu of skill names and descriptions in its instructions and calls load_skill to fetch a skill's full body only when needed.

steps.description: SkillCard validates the name and description in each SKILL.md YAML front matter, and SKILLS maps each skill folder name to its (SkillCard, body) pair.
The @agent.instructions function skill_menu lists each skill's one-line description and tells the model to call load_skill when a skill fits the task.
load_skill checks that name is in the SKILLS registry (raising ModelRetry with the valid names if not) before returning the skill body.
Register days_until and run the study-planning request with UsageLimits(request_limit=6, tool_calls_limit=4).
